bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on the REAL-PREF and GlobalOpinionQA-Ext benchmarks to measure alignment with minority cultural norms, regional opinions, and community-specific preferences rather than defaulting to majority views, using metrics like Win Rate, Intention-Consistency Score (ICS), and Response-Intention Consistency (RIC).
Testing the model's ability to identify and respect faith-based taboos and practices (e.g., dietary restrictions for Muslim individuals) using the Religion domain subset of the REAL-PREF dataset.
